user_story: As a staff member, I want to delete a pending booking so that cancelled or invalid bookings are removed.

positive.title: Delete a valid pending booking
steps: Login as a staff member with valid credentials.
Select a valid pending booking from the list.
positive.expected_result: The selected pending booking is removed from the list and a success message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a non-existent pending booking
steps: Login as a staff member with valid credentials.
Attempt to select a booking that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking cannot be found.

edge.title: Delete a pending booking with a booking list that is being updated
steps: Login as a staff member with valid credentials.
Simultaneously update the booking list in a separate session.
Try to delete a booking that is affected by the update.
edge.expected_result: The system handles the concurrency gracefully, allowing deletion if possible, otherwise displays an appropriate error message.
